title: Optimized transfection protocol for efficient in vitro non-viral polymeric gene delivery to human retinal pigment epithelial cells \(ARPE-19)
protocol: Grow ARPE19 cells in a tissue culture flask until they reach 80% confluence.
Wash the cells with 10 ml D-PBS without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺.
Add 3 ml trypsin 0.25% (1X) with EDTA solution to the flask, mix briefly, and discard most of the trypsin, leaving one drop in the bottle.
Incubate the cells for 4 minutes at 37°C in a tissue culture incubator with humidified, 7% CO₂ atmosphere.
Re-suspend the cells in 9 ml DMEM/F12 medium without serum after confirming by microscopic observation that the cells have detached from the flask bottom.
Stain dead cells with Erythrosin B 0.1% solution and count living cells using a Büchner cell counting chamber.
Dilute the cells with DMEM/F12 medium without serum to achieve a final concentration of 20,000 cells/well.
Seed 50 μl of cell suspension into each well of a black 96-well cell culture plate using a multichannel pipette, cover the plate with the lid.
Incubate the cells for 20 minutes at 37°C in a tissue culture incubator with humidified, 7% CO₂ atmosphere.
Add 50 μl DMEM/F12 culture medium containing 20% FBS to each well using a multichannel pipette.
Incubate the cells overnight at 37°C in a tissue culture incubator with humidified, 7% CO₂ atmosphere.
Dilute 12 μl RL plasmid (1 mg/ml) with 488 μl Mes-Hepes buffered saline in a 5 ml tube.
Incubate the diluted RL plasmid at room temperature for 5 min.
Dilute 25 μl PEI (2.95 mM) with 475 μl Mes-Hepes buffered saline in a 1.5 ml micro tube.
Vortex the PEI solution briefly.
Add all the PEI solution to the DNA dilution and mix rapidly twice with the pipette.
Immediately vortex at 3000 rpm for 2 s after mixing the PEI and DNA solutions.
Incubate the complexes in the safety cabinet for 2 h.
Confirm the formation of nanoparticulates by dynamic light scattering; the size should be ~ 300 nm.
Wash overnight cultured ARPE-19 cells with 150 μl D-PBS (with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺) per well.
Add 100 μl DMEM/F12 medium without serum per well using a multichannel pipette.
Transfer 50 μl nanoparticulates from the clear 96-well plate to the cells with a multichannel pipette.
Leave 4 control wells for each of the following: Mes-Hepes buffered saline, free plasmid DNA (600 ng/well), and free cationic polymer (767 ng/well in the case of PEI at charge ratio 2).
Stir the plate gently.
Incubate for 1 or 2 h in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C, with humidified, 7% CO₂ atmosphere.
Wash ARPE-19 cells with 150 μl D-PBS (with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺) per well.
Add 100 μl DMEM/F12 medium with 10% serum per well.
Incubate overnight in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C, with humidified, 7% CO₂ atmosphere.
Dilute coelenterazine 1 mM solution in D-PBS (with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺) to achieve a 1.5 μM concentration immediately before measurement.
Inject directly 50 μl of coelenterazine 1.5 μM solution into the transfected wells using a luminometer/fluorometer 96-well plate reader.
Measure luminescence for 10 s with a delay of 2 s between injection and measurement.
Add 15 μl Uptiblue (10% of culture volume) per well using a multichannel pipette.
Incubate for 2 h in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C, with humidified, 7% CO₂ atmosphere.
Measure fluorescence ex.540/em.590 nm for 0.1 s.
Wash ARPE-19 cells with 150 μl D-PBS (with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺) per well.
Add 100 μl DMEM/F12 medium with 10% serum per well.
Incubate overnight in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C, with humidified, 7% CO₂ atmosphere.
Repeat the measurements on day 4.
Repeat the measurements on day 5.
Calculate the normalized Renilla Luciferase activity in ng/ml.
Calculate the cell viability in percent relative to buffer-treated wells.
